text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: By the way, did you hear? Apparently they're picking students from our academy for the URA poster again~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eh... You mean that poster Teio-san and McQueen-san did?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep! Who knows, maybe this time we'll get to wear gorgeous dresses and be models ourselves~♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: A chance... to be the models for that poster............

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Dia-chan!
Guess what!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I bet we're thinking the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Let's star on the next poster together!"
Right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Exactly, exactly!!
Let's aim for it together! Becoming poster models!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
And so, you came directly to me to negotiate.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Because McQueen-san and the others mentioned before that they received recommendations through you, Rudolf-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We want to follow in Teio-san and McQueen-san's footsteps! That's why...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, last time the Chairwoman and the Student Council screened candidates and decided the nominees. I was the one who delivered the results to those two as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah! In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However, that was only the case up until last time. This time, selection will be conducted across two screening stages.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The primary screening is a school-wide vote.
Only students who place near the top will proceed to the final screening—an interview with the judges, including myself.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Is that... how it is?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: While I cannot accept your request directly, I certainly acknowledge the initiative and passion that brought you to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you keep putting in daily effort with that spirit, you will surely catch the eyes of your teachers and peers. For now, aim to pass the primary screening first.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There is only diligent endeavor. I look forward to seeing you both at the final screening.
While observing the training track, I spotted Kitasan Black and Satono Diamond running their hearts out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Just one more lap!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! To reach our goal, I want to do everything humanly possible!
They told me about wanting to grace the URA poster together, and about the advice they received from Symboli Rudolf.
choice_data_list: Following in the footsteps of your idols, huh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Seeing Teio-san and the others race is super cool, but—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Those two in that poster just looked so dazzling and radiant!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Even sitting quietly, there was an unyielding strength showing a will to never lose to anyone...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even completely still, you could feel their blazing drive to surge forward from their expressions and gestures...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We want to follow in their footsteps... We were reminded of that all over again!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's why that poster is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The future that we're aiming for!
choice_data_list: I see... I hope you can make it come true!
I see... I hope you can make it come true!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. We'll definitely make it come true together!
Watching them sprint forward toward their dreams left me feeling genuinely inspired.
